serveur.acces.refuse: access denied: home network or Cloudflare Access only
serveur.limite.trop_de_demandes: too many requests in a row: try again in a few seconds
serveur.cle.assistant_humain: only a person (with the code) can give a key
serveur.cle.tuya_humain: only a person (with the code) can give keys
serveur.cle.tuya_pilote_inconnu: no tuya driver with that name
serveur.cle.tuya_invalide: these are not Tuya keys (letters and digits: the Access ID, then the 32-character Access Secret)
serveur.machine.distance_humain: only a person (with the house code) can open the PC remotely
serveur.telephone.foyer_seulement: only the household can pair a phone
serveur.telephone.retrait_humain: only a person (with the code) can remove a phone
serveur.telephone.jeton_refuse: unknown phone or token refused: pair the app again
serveur.plan.humain_arrange: only a person (with the code) can rearrange the plan
serveur.plan.humain_ajoute: only a person (with the code) can add a plan
serveur.plan.type_image: a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image
serveur.plan.trop_de_formes: at most {max} walls, openings or items per floor
serveur.plan.etage_nom: floor name empty, too long or invalid
serveur.plan.etage_sans_taille: “{name}”: a drawn floor needs a size (size, in cm)
serveur.code.proprietaire_seul: only the owner of the house (signed in through Cloudflare Access) can choose the code
serveur.code.trop_d_essais: too many attempts from this device: try again later
serveur.code.installer_d_abord: no code yet: finish setup first
serveur.code.deja_installee: this house already has its code
serveur.code.installation_expiree: setup code expired: restarting Moli gives a new one (in its logs)
serveur.code.installer: no code yet: finish setup (the setup code is in Moli’s logs)
serveur.code.notice_change: The house code has just changed ({by}): all sessions have been closed.
serveur.code.notice_installee: House set up from {key}: it now has its code.
serveur.code.notice_suspendu: {max} wrong codes in under an hour: signing in with a code is suspended for an hour. The house’s commands still work.
serveur.code.journal_installation: first start: open the dashboard (http://<this machine’s address>:8790) and type this setup code
serveur.session.humain_seulement: only a person (with the code) can send this
serveur.camera.piece_protegee: protected room “{room}”: images are for a human session only
serveur.impression.tableau_seulement: printing: from the house’s dashboard only
serveur.impression.trop_lourde: page too large (16 MB at most)
serveur.impression.refusee: the printer won’t accept the document
serveur.systeme.surface.mcp.quoi: Claude, Codex… control it through tools
serveur.garde.machine: command to a machine (printer, computer): a human decides
serveur.garde.remplacee: replaced by a more recent request
serveur.garde.renommer_humain: only a human can rename a device that already has a name
serveur.garde.changer_piece_humain: only a human can change this device’s room ({why})
serveur.coffre.nouvelle_cle: new master key: keep a copy off this machine (backups don’t include it, and without it the vault can’t be read)
serveur.config.depart_non_ecrite: starter configuration not written: default settings, in memory
serveur.energie.point.projection_kwh: Usage this month at the current pace
serveur.energie.point.bill_projection: Bill this month at the current pace (plan fee included)
